faculty.name: John Adams
faculty.summary: Applies creative problem-solving methods to behavioral science research and teaching.
faculty.summary_zh: 应用创造性解决问题的方法进行行为科学的研究和教学。

faculty.name: Analia Albuja
faculty.summary: Studies how people integrate multiple identities and are perceived by others, using experimental, physiological, and developmental approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多重身份的整合及其被他人感知的方式，采用实验、生理和发展性方法。

faculty.name: Iris Berent
faculty.summary: Studies how phonology is constrained by universal principles and how laypeople reason about human nature.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音学是否受普遍原则的约束以及普通人如何推理人类本质。

faculty.name: Peter Bex
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception in dynamic environments and develops treatments for blinding eye diseases using behavioral and computational techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动态环境中的视觉感知，并使用行为和计算技术开发治疗致盲眼病的方法。

faculty.name: Reyyan Bilge
faculty.summary: Studies spatial cognition and episodic memory using various experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间认知和情景记忆，采用多种实验方法。

faculty.name: Kristopher Bradley
faculty.summary: Teaches psychology, statistics, and research design courses.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授心理学、统计学和研究设计课程。

faculty.name: Heather Brenhouse
faculty.summary: Studies how early life stress affects the development of inhibitory interneurons in the prefrontal cortex, leading to behavioral dysfunction later in life.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响前额叶皮层抑制性中间神经元的发展，导致后期行为功能障碍。

faculty.name: Terri Bright
faculty.summary: Develops methods to assess and modify dog behavior, improving shelter dogs' adoptability.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发评估和修改犬类行为的方法，提高收养率。

faculty.name: Jamie Bunce
faculty.summary: Studies how disruptions in prefrontal cortex and medial temporal lobe pathways affect emotional memory integration in anxiety disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层和内侧颞叶通路的中断如何影响焦虑障碍中情绪记忆的整合。

faculty.name: Dawn Cisewski
faculty.summary: Advises students on psychology degree requirements and graduate programs, focusing on adult and geriatric neuropsychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 指导学生完成心理学学位要求和研究生项目，专注于成人和老年神经心理学。

faculty.name: John Coley
faculty.summary: Studies how people organize and use knowledge, reasoning, and conceptual development in various domains like plants and animals, food, and people, using experimental methods with children and adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何组织和运用知识、推理和概念发展，特别是在植物和动物、食物和人的领域，通过实验方法考察儿童和成人的认知广度、深度和灵活性。

faculty.name: Aaron B. Daniels
faculty.summary: Explores the use of imagination in criminal profiling and the intersection of psychology, literature, and spirituality.
faculty.summary_zh: 探索想象在犯罪画像中的应用以及心理学、文学和灵性之间的交叉。

faculty.name: Juliet Davidow
faculty.summary: Studies how learning behaviors change with age, influencing memory, decision-making, and goals in children, adolescents, and adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究随年龄变化的学习行为如何影响记忆、决策和目标。

faculty.name: Elisabetta del Re
faculty.summary: Studies how psychosis develops in relation to genetic and environmental factors, using neuroimaging and genetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的发生与发展与遗传和环境因素的关系，使用神经成像和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: David DeSteno
faculty.summary: Studies how emotions influence decision-making and social behavior, using multiple approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响决策和社会行为，采用多层面的方法。

faculty.name: Amy DiBattista
faculty.summary: Studies how sentence production works, focusing on syntactic planning and lexical selection.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句子生成过程，关注句法规划和词汇选择。

faculty.name: R. Cole Eidson
faculty.summary: Modifies pedagogical approach in psychology courses using AI and experiential learning to promote deeper learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用人工智能和体验式学习调整教学方法，促进更深入的学习。

faculty.name: Rhea Eskew
faculty.summary: Studies color detection and discrimination using psychophysical data and quantitative models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究颜色检测与辨别，使用心理物理学数据和定量模型。

faculty.name: Craig Ferris
faculty.summary: Studies how early risk factors like drugs and social stress alter brain plasticity and behavior in rodents and monkeys, aiming to improve interventions for psychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期风险因素如药物和社交压力如何改变啮齿动物和猴子的大脑可塑性和行为，旨在改善精神疾病干预策略。

faculty.name: Laurel Gabard-Durnam
faculty.summary: Studies how different environments and neuroplasticity interact to shape brain and behavior development, focusing on typical and adverse interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同环境和神经可塑性如何相互作用塑造大脑和行为的发展，重点关注典型和不良的相互作用。

faculty.name: Charles Hillman
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of physical activity on brain health and cognition across the lifespan, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究体育活动对大脑健康和认知功能的影响，使用神经影像技术贯穿整个生命周期。

faculty.name: Jenn Ingemi
faculty.summary: Studies how the nervous system coordinates complex behaviors using the nematode worm, identifying neurotransmitters and neural circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何协调复杂行为，通过秀丽隐杆线虫识别神经递质和神经回路。

faculty.name: Susanne Jaeggi
faculty.summary: Studies how working memory and executive functions can be improved through training, using experimental and neuroscientific methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和执行功能可以通过训练得到改善，使用实验和神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Jennelle Kariotis
faculty.summary: Teaches courses in personality, social psychology, and research design.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授人格、社会心理学和研究设计等课程。

faculty.name: Grayson Kimball
faculty.summary: Works with athletes and executives, providing mental performance coaching and running mental skills training.
faculty.summary_zh: 为运动员和高管提供心理表现辅导，进行长距离跑步的心理技能训练。

faculty.name: MiYoung Kwon
faculty.summary: Studies how visual impairment affects visual perception and brain plasticity, using behavioral experiments, eye tracking, neuroimaging, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉障碍如何影响视觉感知和大脑可塑性，使用行为实验、眼动追踪、神经成像和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Esteban Sebastian Lelo de Larrea-Mancera
faculty.summary: Studies how perception, cognition, and action interact in behavior, using behavioral, electro-physiological, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、认知和行动如何在行为中相互作用，使用行为学、电生理学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Psyche Loui
faculty.summary: Studies the neuroscience of music perception and cognition, exploring brain connectivity and its effects on emotional responses to music.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音乐感知和认知的神经科学，探索大脑连接性及其对音乐情感反应的影响。

faculty.name: Stacy Marsella
faculty.summary: Models human cognition, emotion, and social behavior for health interventions and social skills training.
faculty.summary_zh: 建模人类认知、情绪和社会行为，应用于健康干预和社会技能训练。

faculty.name: Richard Melloni Jr
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of aggression and anxiety, using pharmacology and social stress to understand neural circuits and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究攻击和焦虑的神经生物学，使用药理学和社会压力来理解神经回路和行为。

faculty.name: Stephanie Noble
faculty.summary: Develops tools for precise human neuroscience inference and prediction, combining data science, neuroscience, and open science.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发工具以实现精确的人类神经科学推断和预测，结合数据科学、神经科学和开放科学。

faculty.name: Lace Padilla
faculty.summary: Studies how data visualizations of future events align with human decision-making, using information visualization techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究未来事件的数据可视化如何与人类决策相匹配，使用信息可视化技术。

faculty.name: Jonathan Peelle
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory and cognitive factors interact in speech comprehension, using neuroimaging to understand communication success.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉和认知因素如何在言语理解中相互作用，使用神经成像技术来理解沟通成功。

faculty.name: Mark Prokosch
faculty.summary: Studies the integration of ultimate and proximate explanations of human social-cognitive traits, focusing on mate preferences and individual differences in intelligence and creativity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类社会认知特征的终极和近因解释，重点关注择偶偏好和智力、创造力等个体差异。

faculty.name: Zhenghan Qi
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological organization of language in the human brain, its development from childhood to adulthood, and disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑中语言的神经生物学组织、其从儿童到成年的发育以及神经发育障碍中的中断。

faculty.name: Karen Quigley
faculty.summary: Studies how bodily signals influence emotional experiences and behaviors, using laboratory and daily life measures to understand individual differences in affective responses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究身体信号如何影响情绪体验和行为，使用实验室和日常生活测量来理解个体在情绪反应中的差异。

faculty.name: Brie Reid
faculty.summary: Studies how early social experiences and nutrition affect human development, examining stress, the immune system, and nutrient metabolism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期社会经历和营养如何影响人类发展，考察压力、免疫系统和营养代谢。

faculty.name: Lesley Ricci
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, using evidence-based practices in teaching and research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑系统的行为机制，采用基于证据的教学和研究实践。

faculty.name: David Richters
faculty.summary: Studies low-level detection and discrimination mechanisms for color vision and how eye movements affect perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究颜色视觉的基本检测和辨别机制以及眼动对知觉的影响。

faculty.name: Alexandra Rodman
faculty.summary: Studies how social experiences interact with cognitive and brain development to increase risk for mental health problems during adolescence, using behavioral tasks, neuroimaging, and mobile phone.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年的社会经历如何与认知和大脑发展相互作用，增加心理健康问题的风险，使用行为任务、神经成像和移动电话数据。

faculty.name: Karen Rodriguez
faculty.summary: Studies collaborative memory, metamemory, and social conformity in decision-making, using experimental psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究协作记忆、元记忆和社会一致性在决策中的作用，采用实验心理学方法。

faculty.name: Terri Scott
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of language and working memory using fMRI, electrocorticography, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像、皮层脑电图、计算建模和机器学习研究语言和工作记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Aaron Seitz
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes, learning, and perceptual enhancement using diverse methods and populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程、学习和知觉增强，使用多种方法和人群。

faculty.name: Saba Shahid
faculty.summary: Studies social and health behaviors, using rigorous research and data analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和健康行为，通过严谨的研究和数据分析推进人类行为的理解。

faculty.name: William Sharp
faculty.summary: Studies how individual minds work, focusing on learning difficulties and therapy, using psychoanalytic research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体心理，关注学习障碍和治疗，采用精神分析研究方法。

faculty.name: Summer Sheremata
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes and remembers visual information, using brain imaging techniques to understand everyday tasks and clinical conditions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和记忆视觉信息，使用脑成像技术理解日常任务和临床状况。

faculty.name: Karen Spikes
faculty.summary: Teaches undergraduate courses and provides management consulting in strategic coaching, leadership development, and change management.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授本科课程并提供战略辅导、领导力发展和变革管理方面的管理咨询。

faculty.name: Briony Swire-Thompson
faculty.summary: Studies how people believe in inaccurate information and how to correct misinformation effectively.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何相信错误信息以及如何有效纠正错误信息。

faculty.name: Xiangyun Tang
faculty.summary: Studies the psychosocial development of adolescents and young adults using communication technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻人在通信技术背景下的心理社会发展。

faculty.name: Briana Taylor
faculty.summary: Studies how circadian rhythms and sleep affect daytime functioning in youth with autism spectrum disorder, using computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律和睡眠对自闭症谱系障碍青少年日间功能的影响，采用计算方法。

faculty.name: Jordan Theriault
faculty.summary: Studies brain-based metabolic costs of information encoding and their implications for mental health using neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究信息编码的脑基代谢成本及其对心理健康的影响，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Hilmar von Strünck
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程及其发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Joanna Weaver
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in early childhood and how social-psychological factors influence learning in educational settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期儿童的认知发展以及社会心理因素如何影响教育环境中的学习。

faculty.name: Susan Whitfield-Gabrieli
faculty.summary: Studies brain development and disorders using neuroimaging, focusing on working memory and treatment translation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和障碍，使用神经成像技术，重点关注工作记忆和治疗方法的转化。
